title: 可调预算与费用图表
prompt: “做个旅行预算和分账工具，人数天数可调，标出超支。”
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, interpretation])

intro = Text("先确定人数、天数和总预算，再展开明细调整各项花费。下方金额均为示例数据，可自行修改，不代表真实报价。", "md", "muted")

tool = TravelModule([controls, budgetInput, controlRow, details, summary], "budget", "旅行预算与分账", "拉动滑块或展开明细，结果即时更新")

controls = Row([peopleSlider, daysSlider], 3)
peopleSlider = Slider($people, 1, 12, 1, "人数", "人")
daysSlider = Slider($days, 1, 30, 1, "天数", "天")
budgetInput = Input($totalBudget, "总预算（元）", "number")
controlRow = Row([detailToggle, Spacer(), resetBtn], 2)
detailToggle = Button($showDetails ? "收起费用明细" : "调整费用明细", @Set($showDetails, !$showDetails), "ghost", null, "sm", $showDetails ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down")
resetBtn = Button("恢复示例", @Reset($people, $days, $totalBudget, $hotel, $transport, $food, $tickets, $other), "outline", null, "sm", "rotate-ccw")
details = $showDetails ? Col([Input($hotel, "住宿（元）", "number"), Input($transport, "交通（元）", "number"), Input($food, "餐饮（元）", "number"), Input($tickets, "门票活动（元）", "number"), Input($other, "其他（元）", "number")], 3) : null

summary = Col([Row([Text("总支出 ¥" + totalExpenseFmt + " / 预算 ¥" + budgetFmt, "md", totalExpense > budget ? "danger" : "ink", "semibold"), Spacer(), statusBadge], 2), Text("人均 ¥" + perPersonFmt + "（每日 ¥" + perDayFmt + "）", "sm", "muted")], 2)

statusBadge = totalExpense > budget ? Badge("超支 ¥" + overFmt, "danger", "alert-triangle") : Badge("剩余 ¥" + remainingFmt, "success", "check-circle")

interpretation = Text(totalExpense > budget ? "当前明细已超出预算 ¥" + overFmt + "。可优先压缩住宿或交通，或上调总预算；支出每减少 ¥100，人均每天约少 ¥" + @Round(100 / people / days) + "。" : "当前明细在预算内，剩余 ¥" + remainingFmt + " 可留作机动资金。请注意这些金额均为示例，不是真实报价。", "md", "muted")

$people = 2
$days = 5
$totalBudget = 8000
$hotel = 3000
$transport = 1500
$food = 1500
$tickets = 800
$other = 300
$showDetails = false

people = @Clamp(@Default($people, 2), 1, 12)
days = @Clamp(@Default($days, 5), 1, 30)
budget = @Clamp(@Default($totalBudget, 8000), 0, 1000000)
hotel = @Clamp(@Default($hotel, 0), 0, 1000000)
transport = @Clamp(@Default($transport, 0), 0, 1000000)
food = @Clamp(@Default($food, 0), 0, 1000000)
tickets = @Clamp(@Default($tickets, 0), 0, 1000000)
other = @Clamp(@Default($other, 0), 0, 1000000)

totalExpense = hotel + transport + food + tickets + other
totalExpenseFmt = @Format(totalExpense, "number", 0)
budgetFmt = @Format(budget, "number", 0)
perPerson = @Round(totalExpense / people, 0)
perPersonFmt = @Format(perPerson, "number", 0)
perDay = @Round(totalExpense / people / days, 0)
perDayFmt = @Format(perDay, "number", 0)
over = totalExpense - budget
overFmt = @Format(@Abs(over), "number", 0)
remainingFmt = @Format(budget - totalExpense, "number", 0)
